title: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After the villain Eida's power rewrites everyone's memories, Boruto Uzumaki is branded the killer of his father Naruto and flees Konoha, while his adopted brother Kawaki takes his place (to verify). Years later Boruto returns to protect the village from the god-tree beings created by Code (to verify).
life_message: It holds up loyalty, perseverance and protecting others even when everyone has turned against you.

delivery.note: Loyalty under slander is carried by Boruto's actions; memory-manipulating and god-seeking foes stand for the opposing view.

winners_losers: Boruto, who keeps faith with his village despite slander, wins sympathy; those who manipulate memory and seek godlike power lose. A loyalty-and-duty worldview gets sympathy.
